transkript.t: Never, ever, ever use Cloud Code until you install these five plugins.
Number one is Playwright.
Cloud can't see your screen, so it guesses.
This plugin gives it eyes and hands so that it clicks, tests, and fixes its own work.
Number two is OmniRoute.
Hit your usage limit and you're dead in the water.
This switches you to another model mid-task so that your session never stops.
Number three is Headroom.
Every time you start a new Cloud Code session, it reads everything you've feeded,
junk included, and you pay for all of it.
So what this does is it strips out the noise first,
so you get the same output in a much smaller build.
Number four is Mempalus.
Every new chat you re-explain your business from scratch.
This gives Claude permanent memory of your projects.
Number five, and this is the one we install
on every client project, Frontend Design.
Everything that AI builds sort of looks like AI built it.
And this makes your pages look like you hired a real designer.
Comment Claude below and I'll DM you the full install list.
